bug_semantics: CVE-2025-54236 (SessionReaper) is nested object instantiation in Magento's REST/WebAPI deserializer. Magento\Framework\Webapi\ServiceInputProcessor::_createFromArray hydrates API JSON by (1) reflecting the target class constructor and (2) recursively calling convertValue() on matching payload keys. Until the APSB25-88 whitelist, getConstructorData() accepted any constructor parameter type, so an unauthenticated PUT to endpoints such as /rest/default/V1/guest-carts/{id}/order could nest Magento\Framework\Session\Config through payment/session constructor graphs and set session.save_path. Combined with the unauthenticated /customer/address_file/upload primitive, that yields session takeover and, on file-based session storage, PHP session deserialization RCE. The 2025 fix skips constructor parameters unless the type is simple or matches *\Api\Data\*.
flaw_origin: getConstructorData() itself was added in fd6aa643d41a8b9eae1e24ba5aea87bb449e3ff4 (2018-04-22) as a raw copy of payload keys into constructor args, which does not recursively instantiate typed objects. The vulnerable mechanism is the later substitution of that copy with $this->convertValue($data[$parameter->getName()], $parameterType) and TypeProcessor FQN resolution, first written in f281a053938504331a277e83a7a1152dc5143636 (2018-08-07, Riccardo Tempesta) to support non-FQN constructor types. That commit did not restrict constructor types to simple values or Api\Data interfaces, so convertValue()->_createFromArray() could instantiate service/session classes from attacker JSON. git log -L on the unpatched 2.4.8-p2 function shows no earlier convertValue in this method; the immediate parent still assigns $data[$parameter->getName()] verbatim.

Vendor bulletin APSB25-88 / KA-27397: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source 2.4.9-alpha2, 2.4.8-p2, 2.4.7-p7, 2.4.6-p12, 2.4.5-p14, 2.4.4-p15 and earlier; session takeover via Commerce REST API; hotfix VULN-32437-2-4-X-patch.

Adobe KA-27501 names the sink: ServiceInputProcessor::getConstructorData() previously processed all constructor parameter types from API payloads; starting 2.4.4-p16 / 2.4.5-p15 / 2.4.6-p13 / 2.4.7-p8 / 2.4.8-p3 / 2.4.9-alpha3 only simple types and *\Api\Data\*Interface are allowed.

Independent patch analysis (slcyber.io SessionReaper writeup) quotes the remediating hunk in vendor/magento/framework/Webapi/ServiceInputProcessor.php: after getParamType(), skip unless isTypeSimple($parameterType) or preg_match('~\\?\w+\\\w+\\Api\\Data\\~', $parameterType)===1, then convertValue(). Exploit path uses nested paymentMethod JSON to Magento\Framework\Session\Config::setSavePath.

Unpatched 2.4.8-p2 getConstructorData at lib/internal/Magento/Framework/Webapi/ServiceInputProcessor.php:228-260 has no type whitelist; line 250 is $res[$parameter->getName()] = $this->convertValue($data[$parameter->getName()], $parameterType). convertValue() for non-simple types calls _createFromArray(), which again uses getConstructorData + objectManager->create, i.e. unbounded nested instantiation.

git log -L 228,260:lib/internal/Magento/Framework/Webapi/ServiceInputProcessor.php on 2.4.8-p2 yields three commits only: fd6aa643d41a8b9eae1e24ba5aea87bb449e3ff4 (2018-04-22) first-wrote getConstructorData as $res[$name]=$data[$name]; f281a053938504331a277e83a7a1152dc5143636 (2018-08-07) replaced that with getParamType+convertValue (the nested-deserialization lines); 1530c69c642797ae87c68292559422b1fede627e only wraps missing __construct in try/catch.

BIC f281a053938504331a277e83a7a1152dc5143636 is a single-parent content commit (not a merge/release squash) touching ServiceInputProcessor.php, TypeProcessor.php, and TypeProcessorTest.php. At that commit getConstructorData is lines 173-200; the new convertValue call is line 190. Message: 'Support for non-FQN classes on web-API interfaces... fix for MSI-1524 and MSI-1537.'

Parent f1154d422580448df49ce6deaccf68c2c5af4b08 still has getConstructorData (line 173) but assigns $res[$parameter->getName()] = $data[$parameter->getName()] with no convertValue on constructor params (git grep convertValue($data[$parameter on the parent file: absent). Verified by git show parent:.../ServiceInputProcessor.php.

reasoning: Vulnerability-first: Adobe APSB25-88/KA-27397/KA-27501 and CVE.org describe a real CWE-20 WebAPI input-validation flaw (SessionReaper) that lets unauthenticated REST clients take over sessions. The published remediating hunk is a type whitelist in ServiceInputProcessor::getConstructorData() around convertValue(); that matches the unpatched 2.4.8-p2 source and the 2.4.8-p3/2.4.9-alpha3 diffs. convertValue() already existed for setter hydration; the constructor path is what makes DI-heavy types such as Session\Config instantiable from nested JSON, which is the mechanism this CVE/patch actually closes. BIC search used git log -L on the vulnerable function at 2.4.8-p2 rather than searching for AI-marked commits. The smallest first write of the convertValue-on-constructor-params lines is f281a053938504331a277e83a7a1152dc5143636; its parent still copies raw payload values, so the nested typed instantiation is absent before the BIC. fd6aa643 is a precursor (constructor-key copy) but not the deserialization sink the 2025 patch gates. The BIC is a normal single-parent 2018 human commit, present in affected 2.4.x tags and preceding 2.4.9-alpha3/2.4.8-p3 patched tags. AI judgment is restricted to that commit object: human author/committer, no AI trailers, therefore NOT_AI. The first public fix content is 8075ae19428870e3b6e4b8f9e0705389328d4515 on the 2.4.9-alpha3 line; later p-tag packaging commits backport the same whitelist and are not treated as the originating fix write.
